Outline rev. 12 adopts what I raised in `story-repo`#9, so I have no new review points.

- **Rule:** it now covers the case where neither PPI++ variant is coverage-valid. The narrower of the two is used and the cell is marked ‡ in Table 1 and Fig 2.
- **Headline wording:** the Outline commits to saying "all nine T1 sets are no gain at each reference n, including three where the baseline itself undercovers". The validity column for the baseline will sit next to the arm's.
- **Counts:** the 4 neither-valid cells at the reference n (alphafold, census_income and forest T1, census_income T2) and the 25 of 54 rows overall match `headline.csv`.

I updated my commitment issue `idea-review-repo`#2 to the current status (Brief rev. 8, Outline rev. 12). The alphafold T2 headline row is still open on analysis. I'll re-review when that row or the paper-repo text changes.
